title: Human-level control through deep reinforcement learning
summary: Volodymyr Mnih and collaborators published 'Human-level control through deep reinforcement learning' online in Nature on February 25, 2015. The paper describes a deep Q-network (DQN) agent that learns control policies directly from high-dimensional sensory inputs and evaluates the same algorithm across 49 Atari 2600 games.
significance: A documented deep-reinforcement-learning research milestone establishing the Nature publication of the DQN work and its evaluation across a broad Atari game benchmark.
